# Flare Sweep

**Light › Flare** · v1.0.0 · 30 frames at 30 fps (14–60)

An anamorphic lens flare streaks across the frame and blooms over the cut.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/flare-sweep@1.0.0.mp4) · [Alpha overlay for editing apps](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/flare-sweep@1.0.0-overlay.mov)

## Where it is used

- Sci-fi and trailer looks
- Tech launches
- Night and city footage

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import flareSweep from './transitions/09-light/flare/flare-sweep';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(flareSweep, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 30 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| `hold` | number | `0` | 0–0.3 | Share of the transition at full bloom. |
